scope: Public API composition, existing accepted edits, grid geometry, lifecycle and actual native/Jupyter presentation

findings.trigger: Provide a partial nested bounded/radial style during construction
findings.before: Unspecified themed properties reverted to renderer defaults; partial radial outline dictionaries failed parsing.
findings.after: Restore explicit leaves and merge nested radial defaults; unrelated accepted style and chart data remain unchanged.

findings.trigger: Add an image or contour after editing a mapped scatter colorbar
findings.before: Existing colorbar font, gap and thickness were reset.
findings.after: All mapped constructors use a common colorbar update path preserving appearance while updating the requested map/domain.

findings.trigger: Create a named grid under an extracted weighted-grid style
findings.before: Identity retained uniform weights/default gap while some panel rectangles used the captured layout.
findings.after: Resolve explicit, accepted and inherited layout options once; derive every panel rectangle from that layout.

findings.trigger: Disable Figure style defaults while a constructor waits for the Figure lock
findings.before: The series committed, then the call raised AttributeError.
findings.after: Style selection and construction serialize under the same Figure lock.

validation.software_gpu: Mesa lavapipe native, Chromium 154 SwiftShader browser

presentation_oracle.authored_expectations: Cyan left-panel signal and high-valued yellow magma field must be present on the displayed canvas, in addition to exact model/geometry checks.
presentation_oracle.negative_control: Without the browser-specific ICD selection, the local browser reported Ready and completed GPU work but captured a black canvas. The content assertion failed.
presentation_oracle.positive_control: With the existing CI SwiftShader ICD selection, the same scene and nine analytic displayed-feature scenes pass.

limits: This is not proof of defect-free behavior for every API combination.
Physical Windows/macOS GUI, physical GPU performance and the 74-platform/interpreter release matrix are not established by these local checks.
